hints.title: Index List Mapping
hints.text: Group positions of each distinct element into separate sorted lists.

hints.title: Range Frequency Counting
hints.text: Compute the count of an element in interval l to r by subtracting index offsets.

hints.title: Threshold Filtering
hints.text: Skip any candidate whose overall array occurrences fall short of the query threshold.

hints.title: Reference Implementation
hints.text:
```python
import bisect
from collections import defaultdict
from typing import List

class Solution:
    def subarrayMajority(self, nums: List[int], queries: List[List[int]]) -> List[int]:
        pos = defaultdict(list)
        for idx, val in enumerate(nums):
            pos[val].append(idx)
            
        ans = []
        for l, r, threshold in queries:
            window_size = r - l + 1
            if window_size < threshold:
                ans.append(-1)
                continue
                
            # Check unique elements occurring in the range
            found = -1
            # We can scan candidates with frequency >= threshold
            for val, indices in pos.items():
                if len(indices) < threshold:
                    continue
                # Count occurrences in range [l, r]
                right_idx = bisect.bisect_right(indices, r)
                left_idx = bisect.bisect_left(indices, l)
                cnt = right_idx - left_idx
                if cnt >= threshold:
                    if found == -1 or val < found:
                        found = val
            ans.append(found)
            
        return ans
```

variables: N: Number of elements in array
U: Number of candidate distinct elements
complexity.notes: Stores positions in sorted lists and counts range occurrences via binary search.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning the subarray linearly for every query takes O(Q * N) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Trades O(N) space for index lists to quickly count range frequencies in logarithmic time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use element index lists to count frequencies across arbitrary query intervals.
